facts: Besagew placement, radius and relief are independently authored controls, with optional radial fluting validated at its own owner. RadialFluting shares width/depth policy constants with PlateFluting but uses distinct complete-circle count/radius limits and derives sample columns from current spoke count. Equal wrapper names do not make radial and carrier chart policies interchangeable.

JointExtension derives terminal length from current lame count and terminal_share, and coordinates hem-rounding relation in same validator. Its terminal_share is intentionally irrelevant at one plate. Pauldron front/rear wings are independent morphology; outline and design constraints reuse declared range owners where present, and gauge thickness specialized range is explicit. Current bodies add no evidence of duplicated retained geometry or stale design labels; adopted RIG-ADMISSION03-F052 placement/admission evidence remains distinct and is not cleared by parameter validators.
